description: Manipulates ODS spreadsheet cells. Each operation sets a single cell's value in a specified sheet.

actions.name: set_cell_value
actions.description: Set the value and type of a spreadsheet cell. Cell references use Excel-style notation (A1, B3, Z100).

examples.description: Set cell B2 to numeric value 500

done_action.description: Return this action when the task is fully complete.

tips: Cell IDs in observations use format 'SheetName!CellRef', e.g. 'Sheet1!A1'
Use value_type 'float' for numbers, 'string' for text
Batch ALL required cell writes into a single action's operations array — do it in one shot
Rows and columns are auto-extended if the target cell doesn't exist yet
Numeric values must still be passed as strings in the value field
CRITICAL: Set target to the full document path shown in 'Document path (use as target)'
CRITICAL: After writing, verify the Success Criteria cell exists in the observation — if yes, return done immediately
CRITICAL: If the Success Criteria cell already has the correct value in the Current State, return done without writing
